content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Conventional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal offer an all-in-one platform: payment processing, product hosting, and delivery. They’re convenient for creators in supported countries but are fundamentally rental services. You don’t own the infrastructure—you rent access to it. In contrast, COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack provides sovereign infrastructure: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. The stack is yours to own, not rent. No platform locks you in. No subscriptions. Full data ownership. This architecture is designed for creators in regions where conventional platforms fail. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure built to withstand payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms exclude entire countries based on geopolitical or financial risk assessments. Nigeria, along with many other nations, is often blocked or severely restricted. These platforms prioritize compliance with Western financial systems, leaving creators in excluded regions without access. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack bypasses this entirely by leveraging decentralized infrastructure. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, both of which are globally accessible. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and requires no KYC. The stack is deployed in your own cloud accounts, so no third party can restrict your access. This architecture is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are the norm. It’s built for creators who need infrastructure sovereignty, not platform dependency.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal process payments instantly but charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. They also hold funds for days or weeks, especially for creators in high-risk regions. Crypto payments via NOWPayments confirm on-chain within minutes and cost 0.5% with no additional fees. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. While crypto volatility is a concern, stablecoins like USDT or USDC mitigate this. The real cost of conventional platforms isn’t just fees—it’s the cost of exclusion. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack eliminates both. You pay a one-time fee of $197 for deployment, own the infrastructure, and keep 99.5% of every sale. No recurring fees. No fund holds. No geographic restrictions. This is infrastructure built for creators who value ownership over convenience.
Conventional platforms lock you out. Sovereign infrastructure doesn’t.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Stripe or PayPal, your store, data, and customer relationships belong to the platform. They can shut you down at any time, and you have no recourse. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack gives you full ownership. The store is hosted on your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account. Orders are stored in your Supabase database. Files are delivered via your Cloudflare R2 bucket. Payments are verified via NOWPayments webhooks, which automatically trigger product delivery. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure. You own it. You control it. This architecture is designed for creators who refuse to rent their business. It’s automation without dependency—a stack you own, not a platform you rent.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a country supported by Stripe or PayPal and prioritize convenience over ownership, conventional platforms might work for you—until they don’t. For creators in Nigeria and other excluded regions, these platforms are non-starters. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack is the only architecture built for your reality. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure designed to give you sovereignty. If you sell plugins, templates, or digital products and need a system that works regardless of your location, this is your solution. Deploy once, own forever. No platform can lock you out. No fees eat into your revenue. This is infrastructure for creators who choose ownership over dependency.
